description: Outturn + budget reference for LCC to triangulate transparency-sum against official published figures. Sources listed inline. Refresh this file when LCC publishes 2024/25 Statement of Accounts (expected Nov-Dec 2025; as of April 2026 not yet known to be published).

net_revenue_budget_2024_25.notes: Cabinet-approved net revenue budget for 2024/25. Represents after-grant / after-reserves net call on council tax + RSG. Not directly comparable with transparency-sum — transparency data is gross payments across all funds (including schools DSG, capital, grants passed through).

transparency_sum_gross_2024_04_to_2026_0.notes: Gross sum of every row in 23 monthly CSVs (Apr 2024 – Feb 2026, complete). Includes £140M month-end accrual journal entries (R12) that reverse when invoices clear.

transparency_sum_paid_2024_04_to_2026_02.notes: Transparency gross minus accrual journal class. Closest single-figure to 'money that actually cleared the bank' over the 23-month data window.

procurement_sum_2024_04_to_2026_02.notes: Third-party supplier procurement only — excludes direct payments to individuals (£277M), statutory pass-throughs (£638M), in-house ASC provider transfers (£56M), accrual journals (£140M), BACS settlement noise (£0.6M).

source_portal.download_pattern: /index.asp?Period=MMYYYY&Version=1 (HTML page with CSV-export form; POST action=exportCSV + field list to receive CSV)
notes: Mar-2024 file was amended and Version=2 republished 16 July 2025.
Portal lists 2024 from July onwards as of Apr 2026; this repo's corpus has Apr-Dec 2024 from an older fetch (earlier months may have been withdrawn or rotated out of visible history).
Aug-2024 source CSV was missing from this repo's corpus (misnamed duplicate of Aug-2025 quarantined 2026-04-18). Re-fetched 2026-04-19 via fetch_lcc_spending.py (URL pattern Period=082024&Version=1).
Jan + Feb 2026 months fetched same session. Corpus now complete Apr 2024 – Feb 2026 (23 months).
Mar 2026 not yet published (LCC typically publishes FY year-end in late April or May).
source_portal.fetcher_script: burnley-council/scripts/fetch_lcc_spending.py — run --missing to backfill; --month MM.YYYY for single month; --version N for amended files
